answer: A sybil farm is dense inside and thin outside: clones attest each other freely, but honest strangers ration endorsements. So score each identity by edge-connectivity to several independent anchors: how many disjoint paths link it into the wider economy. A farm hangs by one bridge; cut that link and it floats away, so pay it as one unit however many names it holds. Real connectivity means distinct useful work for many unrelated anchors, each signing a cipher-bound receipt. Forging fails, buying costs more than the payout, and one ember of effort fanned across many names goes cold.
